answer_4.quote: For high-quality human evaluation, we recruited native English speakers from Prolific, a platform specifically designed for research experiments, granting fair payment to annotators.
answer_4.guideline: You will be presented with a series of dialogues between two speakers. For each dialogue your task is to guess the correct biography (Profile) of one of the speakers. There are 3 possible Profiles to choose among (shown at the end of the dialogue as "Profile A", "Profile B", or "Profile C"). Please make your guess even though the dialogue may sound a little weird or unnatural.
